title: From a problem to a checked result.
subtitle: Remote troubleshooting with your AI agent
voice: A remote problem. Your AI agent. A clear path from diagnosis to resolution.

title: Start on the user's computer.
subtitle: Node.js 22.18+ · No AI account needed on this side
voice: The user starts Diagnose and shares a short-lived pairing code privately. Our guide explains how to install Node first.

title: Bring the agent you already use.
subtitle: Codex · Claude Code · Gemini CLI
voice: Launch Codex, Claude Code, or Gemini with Diagnose. Remote tools load for this session, without permanent setup.

title: The user chooses the permissions.
subtitle: Check the self-reported label and session fingerprint
voice: The user confirms the connection locally. Review each task, or explicitly allow automatic execution and transmission for this session.

title: Encrypted between the endpoints.
subtitle: The relay forwards ciphertext, not readable commands or results
voice: Commands and results are encrypted between the endpoints. The relay sees connection metadata. Your chosen AI provider can see the results.

title: Investigate. Then explain the fix.
subtitle: Illustrative example: an application cannot reach its local service
voice: The agent collects evidence and finds a port mismatch. It explains the proposed configuration change, its impact, and how to restore the original.

title: Carry out the authorized repair.
subtitle: Commands, scripts, files, live terminals, networks, and connected devices
voice: With permission, the agent applies the fix. Terminals, files, networks, and device tools support deeper work.

title: Check the original problem again.
subtitle: A command finishing is not proof that the problem is solved
voice: Repeat the failing check, then summarize the result. Local audit events record actions, changes, and data transfers.

title: Diagnose and fix. Remotely.
subtitle: Open source. Human permission.
voice: The user can revoke access anytime. Diagnose and fix, with your AI agent.
